usage.outputShape: body.status (HTTP code), body.ok (bool), body.statusText, body.finalUrl, body.redirected, body.responseTimeMs, body.contentType, body.server, body.timestamp
quirks: Registry surface shows a bare GET with a 'discoverable' http schema and no documented params, but you MUST pass the target as a ?url= query param. Calling it with no url param checks nothing useful.
Pass the full URL including scheme (https://). Response echoes finalUrl with trailing slash added.
Price displayed as 'Varies'; observed cost was ~$0.0038 USDC on Base for one check.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/url/check-status with a ?url= query parameter set to the full target URL you want to health-check (e.g. ?url=https://example.com). It is x402-paid (~$0.0038 USDC on Base), no body, no auth beyond payment. The JSON response returns synchronously: read body.status for the HTTP status code, body.ok for up/down, and body.responseTimeMs for latency. Add the ?url= param yourself — the registry schema is marked discoverable and does not list it.
